units.source_text: 她就同平日习字那样随意写出，叫少将另用纸张包好，送给中将。

en.t: She wrote it casually, just as she usually did when practicing calligraphy, and had Shojo wrap it in another sheet of paper and send it to Chujo.

units.source_text: 少将说：“要送给他，总得抄一抄清楚。”

en.t: Shojo said, "If you are going to send it to him, you should at least copy it out clearly."

units.source_text: 浮舟答道：“抄一遍反而会写坏。”

en.t: Ukifune replied, "If I copy it again, I will only make the writing worse."

units.source_text: 少将就这样送给了中将。

en.t: So Shojo sent it to Chujo just as it was.

units.source_text: 中将得到了答诗，非常珍视，然而已经无可如何，只是悲伤而已。

en.t: Chujo received the reply poem and treasured it deeply, but there was nothing more he could do, and he could only grieve.
